fault_selection: First four object IDs; duplicate asset owner on first two agents, or remove all asset/group/zone ownership for those targets; first remaining admitted control.
natural_selection: Up to four lexicographic multi-hop/unreachable probes and one admitted control; no natural reject is manufactured.
scale_rule: Round-robin pairs across seeded fault units first and natural units second, each group ordered by SHA256(room+variant+seed); retain prefix of complete six-condition blocks within USD1.80. Fixed before responses.
unit: room or mutant; bootstrap resamples parent room clusters with seed20261019,2000 resamples
